notes.title: Trial of Power - Patch 1.5 | 50% OFF!
notes.content:
Hello conquerors,

We're thrilled to introduce the final update to Trials of the Mind! This update brings one of the biggest gameplay twists in this new mode.

It's called "Trial of Power," and it's run on an energy from Seva & Omus which allows for a huge reality alternation.

This time with each wave your units placed on the bench re-roll, allowing to a powerful surprises with merging units or getting a perfect creature to empower your build. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162994/19744242bc1d09dbb9b90b606a492f621b2ca495.png[/img]

The core essence of Trials of the Mind remains intact. Commanders face the daunting task of surviving through 45 relentless waves of enemies, including intense boss fights that will test your commander capabilities. But that's not all – the Trial of Focus offers three distinct difficulty levels, each designed to push your limits as a conqueror. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162994/c0e051d3bade7c66ed70e3e756307070c7bdd99b.png[/img]

Finish them all to unlock heroes statues at the local quarters.

We're also celebrating the launch of this new mode with an exclusive discount available until February 5th, giving you the perfect opportunity to jump into the action and prove your skills!

Have fun!

notes.title: Second wind feature & further balance - patch 1.01
notes.content:
Hello conquerors,

We keep reading your feedback and today we want to address one of the elements that is especially prominent with Gate of Challenges and the full game content: dying unexpectedly.

Our solution is the new gameplay mechanic called "[b]Protection of Chaos[/b]". At each floor you are essentially given one chance to loose the battle and consume the magic barrier instead of being thrown away from the tower. Upon reaching a new floor, its use will replenish, but it's not stackable, so remember that you will be given one chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162994/bcf3023d05afebea9b19cc67a1e9e3c3bd01d6c0.png[/img]

Another instance of players being trapped is entering the most dangerous area without noticing it. 
We've added [b]a gentle on-screen indicator[/b] that shows up whenever reaching the most hostile area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162994/e10cc8688b89fb5ece07027259ce8dacd10fd8af.gif[/img]

To compensate for these changes we've increased the required number of challenges activated via gate. With each successful run, the number increases by 2.

Take a look at the full list:

[h3]New features and balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new feature - Chaos Protection. You begin your run equipped with it. It allows to loose one battle, resulting in the loss of protection instead of being thrown away from the tower. Upon entering a new floor another use is available (a maximum of 1).
[*] Added new feature - upon entering the most hostile zone on the map there is a gentle indicator now visible on screen
[*] Increased the required amount challenges from Gate of Challenges, increasing by 2 after each successful run 
[*] Balanced various challenges from Gate of Challenges
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug limiting the number of decorations to 12 (now all 40 are available)
[*] Fixed building not showing the location of key and boos on the 3rd floor
[*] Fixed various dialogues, volumes and audio balance
[*] Fixed bug blocking players in an instance of getting blessing from the vault while having all of them available (thanks Luki!)
[*] Fixed a bug allowing you to check hidden resources by doing a right mouse-click
[*] Portal to the deepest chamber is now properly marked on the map
[*] Fixed progress towards achievements not counting when having 1 unit deployed 
[/list]

Hello conquerors,

Today we've got by far the biggest new update for Tower of Chaos, focused on three main areas: bug fixes, game balancing and first wave of new Early Access content.

We would like to thank all the members of our Discord community who shared with us save files which helped us a lot to identify and provide fixes for all the bugs. Thank you! <3

[h3]What we did to improve the game balance:[/h3]
It's hard to describe in detail every single change (check out the massive log for it), but in general our idea was to make traps less harsh, bosses slightly more vulnerable and to reduce the effects of high chaos level. All of this combined should much improve your survivability, while the rest of changes make sure it stays engaging and requires tactical approach.

[h3]The most important bugs we have fixed:[/h3]
We've seen multiple reports of invisible walls popping up when reloading save in the exploration mode, and we are happy to confirm this one is gone. If you ran into a bug related to two dragon-turtles fighting or was stuck on the blessing screen, these are resolved too.

notes.title: Major performance patch - 0.63
notes.content:
Hello conquerors,

With today's patch our main focus is two most commonly issues raised by you - [b]to improve the performance and GPU utilization[/b] and to fix issues with the saves that could result in various bugs during exploration.

[h3]What we have done to improve the performance?[/h3]
We decided to focus on two areas - [b]game scalability[/b] and [b]GPU utilization[/b]. 

In order to have the game running with high frame rate on various machines we are [b]introducing Dynamic Resolution[/b]. There are 3 presets: 30, 60 and 120 FPS. The game will adjust the internal rendering resolution on the fly in order to meet the desired frame rate.

Another area is an introduction of an [b]Ultra graphic preset[/b]. It is set on by default, and the main difference are the dynamic unit portraits which are disabled on lower tiers. Use it whenever you need an FPS boost.

The third option addresses stream tearing and GPU utilization by introducing V-sync (vertical synchronization). This option sets the game frame rate according to the refresh rate of your screen, eliminating tearing and reducing the GPU load on higher tier graphic cards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162994/fbb17ddc4d94fc79dc363ce58408c71c44ca1bf7.png[/img]

[h3]What kind of performance gains are achievable?[/h3]
The biggest gains are visible on our Nvidia GT 1030 testing rig, capable now of running Tower of Chaos at 1080p (dynamic resolution) at 60 FPS on a high graphical settings at High 1080p with around 85% of GPU utilization (jump from 15-20 on a similar settings before).

On our RTX 3080Ti laptop testing rig GPU utilization on an ultra preset with 1440p 120 Hz dynamic resolution is now around 68-73%. 

As a result we can now comfortable decrease the minimum system requirements - and you should be able to have 30 FPS on anything higher than GTX 650 from 2012. 

Check out the full list of fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with save file which could result in bugs during exploration
[*] Added V-sync option in the menu
[*] Added "Ultra" graphic preset. High preset has now fixed units portraits, resulting in a huge FPS bump
[*] Added dynamic resolution with 3 presets in the options menu
[*] Fixed issues with god item increasing the humber of available units
[*] Fixed issues with emblems
[*] Fixed an issue with wrong character portrait during one of the tutorial dialogues
[/list]

[url=https://discord.gg/gykM6phF8B][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162994/148a7603227946423a7f915e9475c99156680e22.png[/img][/url]

Thank you for your support and let us know how it run after patch.

notes.title: A new demo for Tower of Chaos is now available!
notes.content:
Hello Conquerors,

Since our Next Fest demo we've gathered tons of valuable feedback that helped us figure out which direction we should follow. After 2 months of hard work we are now ready to showcase you the result of it. 

Out of hundreds of changes the most meaningful are [b]tutorial overhaul[/b] and [b]meta progression tweaks[/b]. Upon a popular request, we also [b]changed the voice actor for Arx[/b]. 

A brand new tutorial is designed to give you more time to familiarize yourself with each of the gameplay mechanics. It takes longer time but features more backstory, proper balance between exploration, fighting and spending time at headquarters. 

With meta progression changes we had one goal in mind - instead of a grind to make you more powerful, we introduced a new buildings mechanic which unlocks specific units. This gives you more time to learn how to command your army and opens up new gameplay mechanics on the exploration map as you progress. 

For the full list check out the huge changelog:

notes.title: Revamped Demo - 5 new features
notes.content:
Hello Conquerors,

The work on the revamped Tower of Chaos demo is progressing and today we would like to highlight some of the biggest changes coming within a few weeks:

[h3]1. Meta Progression Changes[/h3]
We've been reading through a ton of your detailed feedback on improvements to make meta progression more enjoyable. Expect to see tweaks to resources, blessings, potions, and buildings. 

Instead of getting more powerful by acquiring new upgrades, you will now upgrade brand new gameplay paths, allowing for further build variations and altering your tower exploration.

[h3]2. Clarity Improvements[/h3]
The exploration map is visually quite intense, and by slightly tweaking the color grading, introducing pathways, and reducing the intensity of lighting effects, we aim to make it easier on your eyes. Improvements to the UI and combat screens are also in the works.

[h3]3. Reworked tutorial[/h3]
There is a lot of information in the current version of the tutorial, and everything will be more spread out, giving you a chance to familiarize yourself with all the gameplay mechanics. 

[h3]4. Customizable Prompts[/h3]
Based on your experience with auto battlers, you will be able to adjust the amount of hints displayed in the UI. You will also be asked about your lore interest, giving you a lot of flexibility in how often your gameplay is interrupted.


[h3]5. German Localization + Korean and Japanese improvements[/h3]
We've seen a lot of interest from German players, and with a revamped demo, we are going to introduce German subtitles and UI translations! Japanese and Korean localizations will be also improved upon the release of a new demo.

This is only a small glimpse of what is to come - the change log for a revamped demo is going to be as big as Laxox's ego!
